title: MZ Odd Crash in Ritter Ultimate Event Spawner

posts.author: chris-cote
Andar
posts.body:
The error is very likely a timing problem.
correctly read the error message means that either $MapData[mapId] or mapData ist undefined, which means it does not exist. And since it cannot set the property it's likely the first ($MapData) that does not exist.
Or in other words, the plugin tries to run before the game has initialised its map data.
And that likely happens because of a delay, because running the project from inside the editor activates several bughunting and playtesting functions that are skipped when using the external application.
However solving that problem is not really easy - basically someone who knows the code needs to add in a load check if the data loading is complete or wait if not. And I can't help you with that, it goes too deep into the details.

Thanks for the insight!
I had figured it might be a timing thing (hence taking files off my NAS to see if it was maybe a file loading issue), and it sort of explains why adding more plugins seems to cause it to happen more often.
I hadn't tested exporting the game and playing it, though. It never occurred to me that it could be extra processes in the playtest mode. I'll do some more testing on an exported game and see if it continues to happen there. If it is just an editor issue, that would be kind of annoying for playtesting, but not as big of a deal as if it were just a regular crash at least.

This was spot on. I was loading map data asynchronously without waiting for it to load fully before trying to access it, which in most cases it would load fast enough but there was room for failure, a simple callback to wait for the data to load fully fixed the issue in our early testing. Thanks for pointing me in the right direction!
